summary: The Smart tags every package other than SIMAI Framework ships, read for the naming gate (scripts/component-names-kit.mjs, tests/component-names.release-gate.test.mjs): a Framework tag may not be one of them, a package tag starts with a family its owner holds in the name registry (contracts/registry/names.json), and a tag lives in one package -- the one allowed copy is the pro bundle of a set, until the bundle ends. Read on 2026-11-14 from each repository at the revision given (ui-control control/research/2026-11-14-component-sets, data/smart-components.json, commit 13d56e0b). Refresh it when a set releases a new tag. Refreshed 2026-11-16 to the latest releases of pro (pro-2ba35fabb343), view (1.8.1) and chat (1.0.0); their tags are unchanged. Refreshed 2026-11-17 to chart 1.2.0 (chart-f5bff4e90a69): sf-chart-metric is no longer a tag of the set but its dated alias element of sf-tile-metric until 2027-01-01 (journal record tag-sf-chart-metric-to-sf-tile-metric), as pro ships sf-message-log. Since 2026-11-16 (C174, the name gate): each package carries the passport family of every tag (families, read from component.json: pro from its release asset, a set from its repository at the revision), and open lists the problems the gate knows and the package still has to fix; the gate fails on a problem not listed and on a listed one that is gone.
